title: Beauty Improvement
paragraphs: “Yo!”
I shifted slightly, using my spear as a pivot, and tried to peek.
“Second Shield.”
Once again, Father is getting in my way! But I won’t lose!
“I can’t leave this to just Naofumi-san! I’ll use my skill too! Bush Camouflage!”
Itsuki used a skill I’ve never heard of before! Suddenly, the view beyond the fence I was about to see was blocked by mysterious foliage. What is this? I’m not quite sure what kind of skill this is.
“It’s originally a skill that creates bushes to hide in, but it can be used like this too.”
“Hmm… then I’ll go with this. Sword Defense!”
Ren stabbed his sword into the ground, and several swords stood tall in front of me, reinforcing the fence.
“A defense-based skill?”
“Seems like it. It’s similar to Naofumi’s shield in that it blocks incoming attacks. The downside is that the swords have to stay planted in the ground.”
Ugh… these are some troublesome skills they have. At this rate, I won’t be able to see anything easily! However…
“I have a mission to admire everyone’s bare beauty and elevate it!”
“What are you even saying with that serious face!?”
“I heard earlier that by this time, the adventurers and women staying on the island don’t even come to the bath anymore.”
“Well… if you really want to see someone naked, Motoyasu-kun, you’ve got the kind of face where even complete strangers would probably agree to it…”
“What’s fun about looking at a pig’s naked body?”
“Would it be fine if they were Filolials?”
“If you asked, they’d probably just say, ‘Go ahead.’ Do that in your room.”
“There’s meaning in seeing it in the bath! A woman’s beauty increases when she’s admired in the bath!”
“I think about this every night, but… is there really any truth to that?”
“There’s no way… if that were true, it’d be horrifying.”
Father and the others let out heavy sighs.
“Now I understand Naofumi-san’s struggles in the previous loops.”
“Even if you understand that, what’s the point…”
“By the way, Father usually just soaks in the bath. Let’s admire together!”
Come to think of it, there was that one time when Sakura-chan dragged me to the women’s bath.
“I’d rather avoid that if possible…” Father responded while gazing off into the distance.
“Even in the first world, Father didn’t seem that interested in peeping.”
“Obviously! I’ve had terrible experiences with women!”
“When we got caught peeping back then, that lady hurried after Father.”
“Didn’t she think I was the one peeping?”
“After that, she seemed rather disappointed… that’s what left a lasting impression. So, she probably wanted him to look.”
Even before I awakened to true love, I was able to pick up on that much. That lady definitely wanted Father to see her. That’s what love is.
“…You’re connecting it to that?”
“U-Um…”
“Hm? What is it, Imiya?”
I could hear Éclair and the others talking.
“Um, I was just thinking… wouldn’t it be okay for the Shield Hero to see how much we’ve grown…?”
“What are you saying, Imiya?”
“Uh… sorry.”
“Hmm…”
Éclair let out a troubled sigh.
“Imiya, you need to value yourself more. Even if it’s Iwatani-dono. Anyone can tell how much you’ve grown even with your clothes on.”
“Y-Yes…”
“Nano! We’ve got more friends now, nano! Come on, Imiya, let’s have Naofumi take a look too, nano!”
“Stop recruiting!”
Bonk bonk…
“Oh? Looks like Sakura’s time is up.”
With a popping sound, I heard a splash of water. Sakura-chan probably lost interest in peeping and started dozing off in the bath.
“Ugh… that’s still not enough to hold Motoyasu-san down?”
“No choice! Should I use magic to restrain him?”
“Ren, your magic is ice, right? If you do that, the hot spring will freeze, so that’s out!”
“This situation is getting way too troublesome! Éclair! Hurry and get out of the bath!”
“Can’t I even enjoy a soak in peace!?”
Father keeps putting up shields to block me, so I still haven’t been able to peek into the women’s bath tonight.
“If we ask the hotel staff for another bath, Motoyasu and the Filolials will just insist on being somewhere nearby.”
“Should we just give up?”
“That might be an option, but… why do I feel like I shouldn’t let this go?”
“Because it reeks of criminal activity… but if we let him do whatever he wants, Motoyasu-kun will probably lose interest. It’s the whole ‘resisting makes it more fun’ pattern.”
“Should we try it once?”
“And let word spread that the Spear Hero peeps on the women’s bath in this hotel?”

Father and the others were having an intense debate. Ugh… the obstacles set up by Father are proving to be quite formidable! There’s meaning in peeping under these restricted conditions with limited access to the fence!
“For now, Eclair-san, if you want to soak in peace, just wait until later.”
“Got it! Alright, everyone! Haven’t you washed your bodies enough? Time to get out!”
“But Motoyasu-sama hasn’t seen me yet…”
“Mmm… snooze…”
“Gaelion hasn’t peeked into the men’s bath, nano!”
“And what exactly would you accomplish by doing that!?”
“Haah… so noisy.”
Assistant’s sigh was quite memorable. Eventually, the voices faded away. Kuh… I was defeated by Father and the others’ skills today! But next time, I won’t lose!
“By the way, Ren, Itsuki… did you notice?”
Father and the others seemed to be concerned about something.
“Ah, looks like they’re leaving.”
“Doesn’t seem like they got to see anything.”
“Let’s head back.”

When I looked around, I noticed that the Filolials staying on the ship had gotten off and were watching us from a distant mountain. They have excellent vision. Though I’m not quite sure what they’re doing.
“Ah, make sure to discipline the Filolials properly, okay?”
“I know, but… why are they observing the hot spring?”
“Maybe they just want attention?”
“Weren’t they just spectating the whole peeping commotion? But being completely visible from the outside like that… isn’t that a problem?”
“Peeking from afar like they’re sniping is kind of weird too, isn’t it?”
“Itsuki, I’ll give them a warning, but if you see any of them peeking from far away, please snipe them with a paralysis shot.”
“Understood… Since we’re here, why don’t we take a little detour and enjoy the private baths?”
“Good idea. Didn’t Eclair-san and the others head that way too?”
“Seriously! Every night, it’s such a hassle dealing with these battles!”
And so, we left the bath behind. Afterward, Father and the others soaked in a small private bath.
Do they not appreciate the charm of an open-air bath? And just like that, the days on Cal Mira Island flew by.
“Kyah kyah!”
“Yay!”

A heavenly scene unfolded as the Filolials frolicked and enjoyed themselves freely on the beach. Thanks to Father’s management, there were no entry restrictions like last time, and all the Filolials had grown considerably. What was truly unfortunate, however, was that even with so many Filolials around, Filo-tan was not among them.
“I wonder why… Seeing so many Filolials on the beach makes me feel like I might have done something wrong.”
“You knew what you were doing, didn’t you?”
“It’s quite a spectacular sight. Seeing this many of them feels refreshing. So, Naofumi-san, how’s the Filolial research going?”

“I didn’t do it personally, but I kept a close eye on things with the breeders. Originally, the differences were supposed to be minimal, but when they become Filolial Queens or Kings, the differences become much more pronounced.”
“Well then, I’ll throw it now! Everyone, catch it properly!”
“Okay!”
I was completely immersed in playing with the Filolials on the beach. Ah, this place really is heaven. The blue sea, the white clouds… if only Filo-tan were here, everything would be perfect.
